policies.pipeline_final_completion: manifest-defined final checkpoint only; 0 if verified not_reached or Structure not all passed; otherwise (Core passed + Regression passed) / (Core applicable + Regression applicable); equal task-chain weights; incomplete/invalid evidence remains unknown
policies.legacy_groups: Functionality maps to Core exactly once for nodes, required IDs, evaluator totals and inventories; source evidence is unchanged; Error remains required for strict success
policies.sr_regression_failure_rate: binary checkpoint failure (at least one Regression check fails); exclude chain-initial positions, no applicable Regression, delivery/agent failures without valid Regression, missing entrypoints, and incomplete Regression execution; other-group failures alone do not exclude valid Regression results
policies.cost: selected valid trajectory, including failed executed checkpoints
policies.fixed_85: 85% of total prompt input at cache-read rate; 15% input rate; no cache-write charge; output unchanged
policies.core_pass_target_set: all manifest checkpoints, not_reached contributes zero
policies.repeats: each repeat separately; no best-of-k or cross-repeat filling
policies.protocol_equivalence: only explicit manifest mappings after exact complete execution-settings hash verification; original protocol IDs retained
policies.sr_version_compatibility: explicit audited per-SR frozen target and selected-evidence bindings; original decisions retained; unknown alone is never sufficient
